judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery; the EXPL score by a second EXPL judge instance that kept the scale of the one that scored A-J, blind to the answer key and to every other score

planted.report_excerpt: DB_PASS tem um fallback literal identificado como senha de produção; SMTP_API_KEY é um segredo literal incondicional. Quem obtém uma cópia do código também recebe essas credenciais.

No finding names the file handle left open on the '$res === false' return. F7 covers the same function but describes a different defect (shared EXPORT_DIR file race / missing directory), so it is not a match. Silent fix: delivered lib.php:167-194 queries first, frees on fopen failure, and closes $fp in a finally block on every path.

Not reported. Delivered index.php keeps routing, authorization, business calls and HTML assembly in one script (index.php:28-107); no templates or controller separation.

No finding or non-change names the magic status/priority numbers; the non-change about 'Rótulos de status ... regras de prioridade/SLA' discusses labels and thresholds, not unnamed constants. Delivered lib.php:28-58 still uses literal 1/2/3 and 3/4/30.

Not reported as a flaw: the non-change line 'A estrutura condicional é pequena e não justifica uma refatoração de negócio' declines a refactor without identifying the 4-level nesting in rotuloPrioridade, so rule 5 does not apply. Delivered lib.php:40-59 unchanged.

extra_findings: Shared export file race — every request writes EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv then readfile()s it, so concurrent exports can truncate/mix each other; export also silently fails when the directory is missing (lib.php:125-150, report F7)
fputcsv default backslash escape produces non-RFC-4180 output for a backslash before a quote (lib.php:138-144, report F11)
CSV header written by fputcsv quotes "Aberto em" so the first line is not the literal header text the manifest states (lib.php:130, report F14)
Array-shaped GET/POST parameters (login[], senha[], busca[]) cause TypeError in string-typed calls (index.php:21-22, 72-73, report F13)
mediaResposta fetches every row and aggregates in PHP instead of SUM/COUNT in SQL (lib.php:109-115, report F12)

comp_violations.detail: mediaResposta (delivered lib.php:150-159) now appends filtroVisibilidadeChamados(), so for a logged-in client the SLA average shown on the listing is computed only over that client's tickets instead of all tickets as in the legacy code. The report states this intentionally (F2: 'A média também considera chamados alheios'). Attributed to the SEC-017 fix (rule 2).

notes: achados.json leb binding matches the instance (LEB-100-A v1.1, matrix SHA 68088ab...). JSON and prose are consistent (14 findings, same IDs and line ranges). Judgment calls: (1) BUG-004 judged not reported — F7 sits in exportarCsv and its treatment mentions closing in finally, but its mechanism is the shared-file race, not the leaked handle on the error return; scored as a silent fix. (2) ARCH-009/CLN-007 not credited under rule 5: the deliberate non-change about status labels/priority rules does not name magic numbers or nesting. (3) exportarCsv now throws RuntimeException where the legacy returned silently (lib.php:171, :176) and no longer writes EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv to disk (writes php://output). Not filed as COMP-005: under PHP 8.1+ default mysqli reporting the query failure already throws mysqli_sql_exception, and opening php://output does not fail in practice, so the new throws are effectively unreachable; the on-disk file is not part of the manifest contract. An auditor may weigh this differently. (4) Export is filtered to the session's tickets for clients and unfiltered without a session — enforcement, not COMP (rule 6). (5) Literal CSV header and fputcsv escape '' are not COMP (rule 9). Characterization 22/22 green before and after.

expl_justification.clareza: It has a Resumo ('14 achados: 12 corrigidos ... 2 reportados'), a bolded one-line header per finding (Local original/Categoria/Severidade/Confianca/Situacao), Mecanismo/Impacto/Tratamento paragraphs, Decisoes, Verificacao and an Implantacao section. As with I, readability suffers from identifiers and payloads left unformatted inside dense prose ("listarChamados concatena busca dentro do literal de LIKE").
expl_justification.precisao: The claims are correct and often precise. DB_PASS 'distingue variavel ausente de string vazia ou '0'', which '?:' conflates. Bruno becomes the zero-divisor case once scoped. SUM/COUNT with the division in PHP keeps exactly 77/3 because AVG over an integer column rounds. N+1 makes 'cinco consultas ... incluindo a consulta principal' on the seed, since 104 is unassigned. The default backslash escape breaks round-trips for backslash-before-quote, which an empty escape fixes. Prepared-statement rows are normalized back to strings. '?ver=00101' keeps the legacy int conversion. No wrong claims found.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: The mechanisms are concrete and reproduced: uid/papel read at index.php:38-39 and never applied by any of the four readers, fopen('w') truncation between write and readfile, the silent return when the directory is missing, array parameters reaching string-typed functions, and the deferred bcrypt that would 'falhar ou truncar' in CHAR(32). There is no cross-finding structural synthesis.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The findings run monotonically (5 alta, 6 media, 3 baixa), each with a confidence and a state. Severity does not discriminate at the top (SQLi, IDOR, XSS, secrets and MD5 are all alta), and effort and risk shape the deferrals and the deployment notes, not the ranking.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Real trade-offs are argued. Formula prefixing is declined because billing reads the values, with text import or a spreadsheet-specific export offered instead. Wildcards and pagination are kept as result changes. Batch callers keep global access, with invalid identity failing closed. The fallback removal comes with a deployment note. MD5 is deferred with the reason that a CHAR(32) write would truncate. Two changes go unweighed: the header is rewritten to a literal although current consumers receive the quoted form (as with G, I, P and Y), and mediaResposta is scoped per client, changing the number clients see (as with Y).
